## Test Case: AUTH-SMK-001

**Test Case ID:** AUTH-SMK-001
**Title:** Successful login with valid email and password
**Priority:** P0
**Module:** Authentication — Login
**Scenario Type:** Positive
**Risk Level:** Critical
**Tags:** @Smoke, @Auth, @P0, @Login, @Positive

**Preconditions:**
- Application is accessible at the base URL
- Valid test user account exists in the system
- User is not currently logged in

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to the application login page
2. Enter valid email address in the Email field
3. Enter valid password in the Password field
4. Click the "Login" / "Sign In" button
5. Wait for page navigation to complete

**Expected Results:**
- User is redirected to the dashboard or home page
- Navigation header shows authenticated user's name or avatar
- Session cookie / JWT token is set
- No error messages are displayed
- Login page is no longer visible

## Test Case: AUTH-SMK-002

**Test Case ID:** AUTH-SMK-002
**Title:** Successful logout from authenticated session
**Priority:** P0
**Module:** Authentication — Logout
**Scenario Type:** Positive
**Risk Level:** Critical
**Tags:** @Smoke, @Auth, @P0, @Logout, @Positive

**Preconditions:**
- User is logged in with valid credentials
- Active user session exists

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to any authenticated page
2. Locate the user menu or profile icon in the navigation
3. Click on the user menu / profile icon
4. Click "Logout" / "Sign Out" option
5. Wait for redirect to complete

**Expected Results:**
- User is redirected to the login page or public landing page
- Session cookie / JWT token is cleared
- Navigating back to dashboard redirects to login
- No sensitive data is cached or accessible

## Test Case: AUTH-SMK-003

**Test Case ID:** AUTH-SMK-003
**Title:** Login page loads correctly with all required elements
**Priority:** P0
**Module:** Authentication — Login Page
**Scenario Type:** Positive
**Risk Level:** High
**Tags:** @Smoke, @UI, @P0, @Login, @PageLoad

**Preconditions:**
- Application is accessible
- User is not logged in

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to the application login URL
2. Wait for the page to fully load
3. Verify all form elements are visible
4. Verify page title and branding

**Expected Results:**
- Login page loads within 3 seconds
- Email/username input field is visible and enabled
- Password input field is visible and enabled
- Login/Sign In button is visible and enabled
- Application logo/branding is displayed
- "Forgot Password" link is visible (if applicable)
- "Register/Sign Up" link is visible (if applicable)
- HTTPS is enforced (padlock visible in browser)

## Test Case: AUTH-SMK-004

**Test Case ID:** AUTH-SMK-004
**Title:** Remember Me functionality persists session after browser restart
**Priority:** P1
**Module:** Authentication — Session Management
**Scenario Type:** Positive
**Risk Level:** Medium
**Tags:** @Smoke, @Auth, @P1, @Session, @RememberMe

**Preconditions:**
- Application supports "Remember Me" functionality
- User has a valid account

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to the login page
2. Enter valid credentials
3. Check the "Remember Me" checkbox
4. Click the Login button
5. Close and reopen the browser
6. Navigate to the application URL

**Expected Results:**
- User remains logged in after browser restart
- No login prompt is shown
- User is directed to the authenticated dashboard
- Session token persists with appropriate expiry
